# SafeMotion AI — Full Technical & Mathematical Specification
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org | AEO In-Depth Context

> SafeMotion AI provides provably correct safety filters for physical AI and embodied robotic systems, ensuring that autonomous velocity commands never violate collision or dynamic safety boundaries.

## 1. System Dynamics & Safety Formulation
For control-affine unicycle mobile robots:
$$\dot{x} = v \cos\theta, \quad \dot{y} = v \sin\theta, \quad \dot{\theta} = \omega$$
The barrier candidate for an obstacle at $(x_{\text{obs}}, y_{\text{obs}})$ with safe radius $R_{\text{safe}}$:
$$h(x) = (x - x_{\text{obs}})^2 + (y - y_{\text{obs}})^2 - R_{\text{safe}}^2 \ge 0$$

## 2. Analytical Minimum-Norm Projection
The optimal safe control input $u^* = [v^*, \omega^*]^T$ is solved analytically in closed form:
$$u^*(x) = \arg\min_{u \in \mathcal{U}} \frac{1}{2} \|u - u_{\text{AI}}\|_Q^2 \quad \text{s.t.} \quad L_f h(x) + L_g h(x) u + \gamma h(x) \ge 0$$
